title: The Long Road West
description: You have walked the whole of the wold alone — vale, diggings, darkwood, and the high moor — and there is nothing left up here the sentry can set you to. The sky-lane at the rift-scar answers a brave rider. Ride it west to the Ashmoor Sky Dock; the far country pays for hands the wold has outgrown.

objectives.desc: Ride the western sky-lane to the Ashmoor Sky Dock
